title: Sites
subtitle: Websites the agent studies and keeps as tables

list.emptyBody: Add a site and the agent will study it, then propose tables for you to approve.
list.emptyBodyNoCreate: Nobody has shared a site with you yet.

add.title: Add site
add.subtitle: The agent studies it, then proposes tables for you to approve
add.name: Name
add.nameHint: Optional — defaults to the site's host name.
add.loginHint: The agent studies the public pages first, then signs in for the rest. The password is saved for this site only and never shown again.
add.loginBoth: Enter both a username and a password, or neither.
add.visibilityPrivate: Only me (profile owner and admins can still manage it)
add.visibilityShared: Me and people I pick (read access — change it later in Sharing)
add.next: Next: ask the agent in Chat to study the site. Its proposed design appears on the site's Design tab.
add.notAllowedBody: Ask the owner or an admin to add it, or to let your role add sites.

detail.loginMissing: Login URL set, no saved login
detail.proposalWaiting: Design v{version} is waiting for approval.

design.noneBody: The agent hasn't proposed tables for this site. Ask it in Chat to study the site.
design.appliedBody: {count} schema change(s) applied. Existing tables and columns are never dropped.
design.readOnly: You have read access: a site admin approves designs.
design.confirmBody: New tables and columns are created now. Nothing existing is dropped.
design.confirmBodyQuestions: The agent still has {count} open question(s). Approving applies the design as proposed; nothing existing is dropped.

data.none: No tables yet — they appear once a design is approved.

runs.needsDesign: Approve a design before the first refresh.

modeHint.incremental: Only new and changed records since the last run. Nothing is marked removed.
modeHint.full: Re-read everything. Rows no longer on the site are marked removed (never deleted).

sharing.levels: Read: see data and history, export. Admin: also approve designs, refresh, schedule and share.
sharing.revokeBody: They stop seeing this site and its data straight away.

schedule.title: Automatic refresh
schedule.manualOnly: No schedule — refresh by hand from Runs.
schedule.pausedNote: The site is paused, so it won't run until resumed.
schedule.readOnly: You have read access: a site admin sets the schedule.
schedule.perTableHint: From the approved design. Ask the agent to change a table's plan; it comes back as a new design to approve.
